text: My husband has emailed twice about the heating at 14b Alder Court, no one has responded. We have a 7 month old baby. What is going on.

issues.summary_en: Heating problem at 14b Alder Court reported twice with no response; a 7-month-old baby lives in the home.
issues.explanation: A heating fault that has gone unanswered in a home with a young baby should be treated as an emergency.
